lead_decision: Typed roles are approved for a dedicated slice after 6e3. The six rows remain pending; this analysis is historical, not an outstanding approval request.
stop_reason: Existing ordinary-column mutator support and primary-role-erasing adapters prevent exact static exclusion by changing only source-write target constraints. Timestamp/soft-delete aliases are not distinct roles. The lane rule requires reporting this rather than guessing at an accepted declaration/API migration.

rows.reason: Input* columns identify dedicated mutation inputs, but accepted same-type/discovered mutators also use ordinary Text/Number/etc. Excluding Input* does not exclude those values. A Go constraint cannot distinguish two values of the same concrete type by runtime declaration metadata.
rows.nearest_static_option: Require every mutated field, including same-input discovered mutators, to use Input* and reject the currently supported ordinary-column mutator declarations. Then exclude Input* with a closed constraint. This changes the accepted Stage 5 declaration contract.
rows.cost_note: No conforming complete option under unchanged declaration contracts. Marker-only lower bound is zero extra functions; full declaration migration not implemented or priced.

rows.reason: Key is nominal, but KeyColumn is a comparable-column interface, not a primary-role type. NumberKey and TextKey return ordinary Number and Text, erasing primary ownership at the static boundary. Excluding Key alone leaves both supported adapters accepted.
rows.nearest_static_option: Preserve a nominal primary role through NumberKey/TextKey and close the mapping constraint. This changes pinned adapter return types; preserving all existing capabilities needs a broader type/API migration under the no-new-column-methods limit.
rows.cost_note: No conforming complete option with pinned adapter return types. Methodless role-carrier overhead measured zero; retained adapter method specialization cost not measured.

rows.reason: UpdatedAt is an alias of Time; UpdatedAtOf returns Time. Conventional UpdatedAt fields also bind through ordinary TimeOf. A new marker cannot distinguish already-erased Time values while those declarations remain source-write eligible.
rows.nearest_static_option: Introduce a nominal managed-timestamp role and preserve it in constructors/declarations; migrate conventional managed fields and restrict source targets. Replacing the alias/constructor return type changes pinned public signatures; retaining ordinary convention declarations leaves the same static hole.
rows.cost_note: Methodless marker lower bound is zero extra functions; full role-preserving time API cost is unmeasured and requires a declaration/API migration.

rows.reason: There is no typed soft-delete model capability in the current tree. SoftDelete aliases NullableTime; ForceDelete is on every Table. soft_force_key rejects a different model key, not a non-soft model.
rows.nearest_static_option: Add a non-forgeable methodless soft-delete declaration carrier and require it at ForceDeleteUsing. This role has no existing typed carrier, so a new marker is permitted by the brief; implementation was stopped because the other rows require contract migration.
rows.cost_note: Carrier-only lower bound measured zero extra functions. A complete constructor/bridge and consumer probe is not implemented or measured.

marker_lower_bound.interpretation: Methodless carrier lower bound only. It does not measure a complete static API or solve role-erasing existing constructors. No budget is proposed.
marker_lower_bound.warning: This is not a complete static solution and is not its total footprint cost. No method set, capability validation or declaration compatibility claim follows from this measurement.
